skills.name: Dropkick
skills.description: Dashes at enemies and dropkicks them. Bad effects on enemies.  *ATK x 2800% Area Damage  *Enemy ATK -40% (10 sec) *Enemy Skill Use Rate -40% (10 sec)

skills.name: Go Halves
skills.description: Baji appears and crouches down to eat frying noodles. Good effects on allies.  *ATK +300% (7 sec) *Skill Use Rate +50%  (7 sec) *Skill Evade Rate +60% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Tokyo Revengers
abilities.description: Tokyo Revengers Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and HP buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Revive
abilities.description: Rangers will have a high chance of being revived when they are defeated. Rangers will be revived with 70% HP. This Ability will only activate once.
